# WC3V

> Free, open-source Warcraft III replay analysis and a curated library of
> 16 pro build orders backed by 351 parsed tournament games.
> Replay files are parsed entirely in the visitor's browser and never uploaded.

Every page below also exists as Markdown at the same URL with a .md suffix,
and is served as text/markdown to requests that ask for it via Accept.

## Pages

- [WC3V — Pro Build Orders, In-Browser Replay Analysis & Pro Comparison](https://wc3v.com/index.md): Free Warcraft III build order library and replay analyzer. Browse pro builds by race and matchup, drop a .w3g to analyze it locally in your browser (never uploaded), or compare your replay to a pro's with letter-graded macro, tech, expansion, and build-order feedback.
- [WC3V Build Finder, Starter Warcraft III Builds for New Players](https://wc3v.com/learn.md): Pick your race, then your hero, then the army you like the look of. The Build Finder gives you one Warcraft III build to learn and a pro replay where someone plays it, with a walkthrough that stops at every step.
- [About WC3V - Visual Build Order & Replay Analyzer for Warcraft III](https://wc3v.com/about.md): WC3V is a visual build order and replay simulator for Warcraft III. Upload .w3g replays for full breakdowns of builds, heroes, units, upgrades, and minimap playback. Free, open source, and built for the WC3 community.
- [Community Resources - Warcraft III Sites & Tools | WC3V](https://wc3v.com/community.md): A hand-picked list of trusted Warcraft III community sites, tools, and resources: Liquipedia, W3Champions, Back2Warcraft, Hive Workshop, and the open-source tools that power WC3V.
- [Download WC3V Desktop | WC3V](https://wc3v.com/download.md): Download the WC3V desktop app for Windows. Check the version and checksum, read the disclosures, and get the installer straight from our CDN.

## Build orders

- [Warcraft III build orders](https://wc3v.com/builds.md): 16 curated builds by race and matchup, each backed by a tournament replay
- [DK Fiend Standard](https://wc3v.com/builds/udo-dk-fast-fiend.md): Undead, UvO, UvH, UvU. A simple Undead build for new players. Death Knight opener, Ghouls mine lumber, and your fighting army is Crypt Fiends -- you never have to micro Ghouls…
- [DK Destroyer](https://wc3v.com/builds/ud-dk-destroyer.md): Undead, UvN, UvH, UvO. DK Fiend opener that priorities a fast T3 for Destroyer tech. Destroyers' Devour Magic hard-counters caster-heavy armies like NE Dryads or HU Priests.
- [BM Wind Rider](https://wc3v.com/builds/orc-bm-wind-rider.md): Orc, OvU. Blademaster opener with heavy early harassment, transitioning into Wind Rider air superiority. Denies expansion and wins on economic disruption.
- [FS Headhunter](https://wc3v.com/builds/orc-fs-headhunter-shaman.md): Orc, OvU, OvH. Far Seer opener with Headhunters and Shamans. The most versatile Orc opener — Bloodlust makes Headhunters burst targets down, Hex and Purge shut down…
- [BM Grunt Standard](https://wc3v.com/builds/orc-bm-grunt-push.md): Orc, OvN, OvU. Blademaster opener into mass Grunts for an aggressive ground push. BM harasses workers while Grunts pressure the front door. Transitions into Spirit…
- [AM Caster](https://wc3v.com/builds/hu-am-caster.md): Human, HvN, HvO, HvU. Archmage into Footmen, then Priests and Spell Breakers at T2. The dominant Human build in the current meta. Inner Fire buffs Footmen, Spell Steal counters…
- [AM Rifle](https://wc3v.com/builds/hu-am-rifle.md): Human, HvN, HvH, HvO. Archmage into Footmen transitioning to Riflemen and Sorceresses. Rifle range controls space, Slow from Sorceresses kites melee armies.
- [MK Fast Expand](https://wc3v.com/builds/hu-mk-fast-expand.md): Human, HvU, HvN. Mountain King first into fast expansion. Storm Bolt stuns harassers, Bash provides melee dominance. Build army to 60 food then upgrade to Castle for Knights.
- [KotG Mountain Giant](https://wc3v.com/builds/ne-kotg-mountain-giant.md): Night Elf, EvH, EvO, EvU, EvE. Keeper of the Grove opener into Mountain Giant tank line. Entangle roots Human heroes, Giants taunt Human armies, and Treant summons provide free…
- [DH Standard](https://wc3v.com/builds/ne-dh-fast-bear.md): Night Elf, EvU, EvO, EvH. The standard Night Elf build. Demon Hunter first for Manaburn harassment, fast tech to T3 for Druid of the Claw (bears). Bears in Bear Form have massive…
- [DH Mass Talons](https://wc3v.com/builds/ne-dh-mass-talons.md): Night Elf, EvO. Demon Hunter into mass Druids of the Talon with Cyclone spam. Exploits Orc's limited dispel options. Cyclone removes key units from fights, Faerie Fire…
- [DK Gargoyle](https://wc3v.com/builds/ud-dk-mass-gargoyle.md): Undead, UvO. DK opener into mass Ghouls for lumber, then flood Gargoyles from multiple Crypts. Air superiority overwhelms Orc ground armies. Dark Ranger or Dreadlord…
- [Lich Fast Tech](https://wc3v.com/builds/ud-lich-fast-tech.md): Undead, UvH, UvU, UvO. Lich first hero for early Frost Armor tankiness and Frost Nova burst. Slightly defensive opener that creeps with Ghouls and rushes T2 Crypt Fiends. DK as…
- [PotM Mass Huntress](https://wc3v.com/builds/ne-potm-mass-hunts.md): Night Elf, EvH, EvE, EvO. PotM first hero for Trueshot Aura damage boost and Searing Arrows hero harass. Mass Huntresses provide ranged DPS and Sentinel scout vision. Strong…
- [Paladin Rifle](https://wc3v.com/builds/hu-paladin-rifle.md): Human, HvO, HvN, HvU. Paladin first hero for Holy Light sustain on early Footmen. Tower up at base, mass Riflemen with Priest support. Defensive opener that scales into a…
- [Crypt Lord Standard](https://wc3v.com/builds/ud-cl-standard.md): Undead, UvH, UvN, UvO. Crypt Lord first hero for Carrion Beetles map presence and Impale stun. Ghoul opener like other UD builds, transitions to Crypt Fiends and Statues at T2.…

## Data & APIs

- [Replay Data API | WC3V](https://wc3v.com/api.md): A free, read-only JSON API over 192 parsed Warcraft III tournament replays. No keys, no auth, no rate limits. OpenAPI 3.1 description included.

## Policies

- [Privacy Policy | WC3V](https://wc3v.com/privacy.md): Privacy policy for WC3V. Replays are parsed in your browser and never uploaded. We don't sell your data because we don't have any.
- [Terms of Service | WC3V](https://wc3v.com/terms.md): Terms of service for WC3V, a free Warcraft III replay analyzer and build order library. As-is, no warranty, US governing law.
